_comment: Regression baseline for the shared-memory transport gate. Values are the recorded median-of-N numbers from bench/shm/REPORT.md's summary table (regime=default), for the 64-byte, concurrency-1 cells. Ratios used by the gate are computed from these p50 medians, not stored, so nothing here is a hand-picked ratio. To refresh, recapture a bench run and copy the medians bench/shm/REPORT.md records; do not hand-edit measured values.
